n9ac4ae7225.headline: Czech Railways Will Raise Fares After Two Years. Passengers Will Pay One Crown More for Trips up to 120 km | Aktuálně.cz
n9ac4ae7225.summary: Czech Railways announced a fare increase of one crown for trips up to 120 kilometers, effective December 11, 2017.
n9ac4ae7225.why: Fare increases impact transportation costs and consumer spending in the Czech Republic.
